chapter: Discovering jazz and playing in Berlin
title: Opening and introduction of Frank Naundorf
summary: Dick Allen sets up the microphone; Spilla Franke introduces the interview, date, location and Naundorf's age.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places
story.community_name: Interview openings: names, dates and tape setup

blocks.x: You don't have to talk into it. Don't be conscious of the microphone. Just talk a little bit. One. It lies all the time.

My name is Spilla Franke. I work for the Jazz Archive at Tulane University, and I'm interviewing Frank Naundorf, who is from Berlin, Germany. The interview is going to be in German, mainly, except for some questions. This is February 25th, 1965. We're in the Barracks 27, the temporary quarters of the Jazz Archive now. Frank, how old are you?
